visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair in pigtails and a white lace blouse leans her head against the stomach of a man wearing a pink denim jacket. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space with a white wall featuring stylized logo text. As she smiles and speaks, animated white bubbles and laughing face emojis appear as graphical overlays on the screen. The man places his hand on the back of her head, smiling broadly with his eyes squinted in laughter. (2) The scene shifts to a mall interior where a stage is set up with 'Brave Little Days' and 'TOYSELECT' branding. The woman, now in a pink patterned dress, stands on stage holding a pink smartphone case with a cartoon design. Beside her, the man in the pink jacket holds a microphone and a script, engaging with her and the visible audience. Cameras and phones from the crowd are visible in the foreground, capturing the event under bright studio-style ceiling lights. (3) A fan joins the two main characters on stage, and they all hold microphones, singing together with visible joy. The camera cuts to the woman waving enthusiastically to a large crowd of young fans gathered behind a red velvet rope in the mall. Finally, close-up shots showcase a variety of decorative smartphone cases displayed on a wooden shelf in a retail setting, illuminated by soft store lighting.
